test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Libero, a special player, plays in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Volleyball**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Libero is a special player in **Volleyball**.
 
• The Libero is a defensive specialist who cannot attack the ball above the net's height.
 
• This player wears a different color jersey and cannot serve, block, or attempt to block.
 
• The Libero's primary role is to improve the team's reception and defense.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football: **

 
 
• Played with 11 players per team, aiming to score goals by getting a ball into the opponent’s net.
 
• The game lasts **90** minutes, divided into two **45-minute halves.**
 
• Major tournaments include the FIFA World Cup.
 
 
 
• **Basketball**:
 
 
• Teams of 5 players each try to score points by shooting a ball through a 10-foot-high hoop.
 
• A standard game consists of four **12-minute quarters.**
 
• Prominent leagues include the **NBA and EuroLeague.**
 
 
 
• **Handball: **
 
 
• Each team has 7 players, including a goalkeeper, and aims to score goals by throwing a ball into the opposing team’s net.
 
• Games are typically played in two **30-minute halves.**
 
• The IHF World Handball Championship is a key event.
